_meta.description: Multilingual name dictionary for HoMM3 SoD/HotA objects, parsed from the original editor Data/*.txt files. Each language is a DICT keyed by integer ID (as string), preserving the IDs from the source files. Also serves as the single source of truth for synonym groups — all translations of the same ID across languages are treated as synonyms by excel_compare.py.
notes: Languages are DICTS keyed by string ID (e.g. '0', '1', ...).
Use localizer.section(name, int_id) for language-aware lookup.
If a string is missing for a specific language, fallback to default (ru_sod).
IDs preserved 1:1 from source files — same IDs used in save file binary data.
Synonym groups are derived AUTOMATICALLY at runtime by excel_compare.py:
all translations of the same (section, id) across the 4 languages are synonyms.
No separate synonyms.json file needed — this file is the single source of truth.
To extend with custom synonym groups (for terms NOT in any section), add them
to the top-level 'synonyms_extra' key (list of string lists).
To extend with new translations, add entries to the appropriate section/language
dict, or extend the .txt source files and re-run scripts/build_localization_dict.py.
